sources.name: TheCocktailDB
sources.use: Official API recipe records; bounded named-family searches. Retain source links.
sources.termsNote: Published terms permit copying/modifying API content. Free key is for development/education; public app-store release requires paid access. Third-party content has separate rights. The terms page currently contains a TheMealDB naming inconsistency.
sources.images: Recipe-specific API thumbnail hot-linked for personal/development use, with source/photographer credit; no image bytes bundled. strCreativeCommonsConfirmed metadata retained; do not infer redistribution permission from a No flag.

sources.termsNote: API content copying is permitted under source terms; public app-store release requires paid access. Third-party content has separate rights.

sources.termsNote: Copyright retained by publisher. Privacy policy is not a reuse licence; no blanket redistribution permission was established. Keep this separate from openly licensed data.

admission: Require source URL, name, ingredients and instructions.
Do not invent measures, yields, time or nutrition.
Keep API alcohol classification; unknown is not alcohol-free.
Deduplicate by source URL or source ID, retaining distinct publisher versions.
Keep generated records separate from saved user recipes.
Record acquisition failures and actual country coverage.
